# Hand-checked edges for ts_shop (TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript).
# Format: [!]KIND TIER SRC -> DST. Module names are file paths without extension.

# inheritance, this, super, class-field initialisers
INHERITS T1 src/billing/invoice.Invoice -> src/core/base.Model
INHERITS T1 src/core/memory_repo.MemoryRepo -> src/core/base.Repo
CALLS T1 src/core/memory_repo.lookup -> src/core/base.Repo.find
CALLS T1 src/billing/invoice.Invoice.total -> src/billing/invoice.Invoice.subtotal
CALLS T1 src/billing/invoice.Invoice.total -> src/billing/tax.TaxCalculator.compute
CALLS T1 src/billing/invoice.Invoice.save -> src/core/base.Model.save
CALLS T1 src/billing/invoice.Invoice.save -> src/core/base.Model.validate
CALLS T1 src/core/base.Model.save -> src/core/base.Model.write
CALLS T1 src/billing/tax.TaxCalculator.compute -> src/billing/tax.roundMoney

# tsconfig path alias -> index.ts -> `export { default as Invoice }`; new; typed locals
CALLS T1 src/api.checkout -> src/billing/invoice.Invoice
CALLS T1 src/api.checkout -> src/billing/invoice.Invoice.save
CALLS T1 src/api.checkout -> src/billing/invoice.Invoice.total
!CALLS T1 src/api.checkout -> src/core/base.Model.save

# `./tax.js` specifier pointing at tax.ts; typed parameter on an arrow function
CALLS T1 src/api.quote -> src/billing/tax.TaxCalculator.compute

# declared return type; interface method through a generic parameter type;
# a function reached through `export *` in an index file
CALLS T1 src/api.fresh -> src/billing/invoice.Invoice.total
CALLS T1 src/api.load -> src/core/base.Repo.find
CALLS T1 src/api.load -> src/billing/tax.roundMoney

IMPORTS T1 src/api -> src/billing/index
IMPORTS T1 src/billing/invoice -> src/core/base

# JSX components (intrinsic tags like <div> are not calls), call inside a callback
CALLS T1 src/ui/App.App -> src/ui/App.Layout
CALLS T1 src/ui/App.App -> src/ui/Button.Button
CALLS T1 src/ui/App.App -> src/api.checkout

# plain JavaScript
CALLS T1 scripts/report.main -> scripts/report.helperOnly

# untyped receiver with two candidates; guards against the Python-era false positives
CALLS T0-ambiguous src/views.show -> src/views.HtmlView.render
CALLS T0-ambiguous src/views.show -> src/views.JsonView.render
!CALLS T0 src/views.touch -> src/views.Registry.set
!CALLS T0 src/views.shadow -> src/billing/tax.roundMoney

# workspace package imported by name: exports "." (source condition) and "./button"
CALLS T1 src/ui/App.App -> packages/ui-kit/src/card.Card
CALLS T1 src/ui/App.App -> packages/ui-kit/src/button.bigButton

# a chain rooted at an npm package is external, never a repo name match
!CALLS T0-ambiguous src/api.load -> src/views.HtmlView.render

# `export { _void as void }` inside a module; a known module lacking the member
CALLS T1 src/api.aliasUse -> src/billing/tax._void
!CALLS T0 src/api.aliasUse -> src/views.Mocker.void
!CALLS T0-ambiguous src/api.missingMember -> src/views.HtmlView.render

# TypeScript: a unique method name on an untyped receiver is labelled ambiguous
CALLS T0-ambiguous src/views.scanUntyped -> src/views.Scanner.scanOnce
